# namespace_github_runner_profiles (Data Source)

Lists all Namespace Cloud GitHub Actions runner profiles in the workspace, sorted deterministically by profile_id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    namespace = {
      source = "bsuv/namespace"
    }
  }
}

data "namespace_github_runner_profiles" "all" {}

output "all_profile_tags" {
  value = [for p in data.namespace_github_runner_profiles.all.profiles : p.tag]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier for this data source.
- `profiles` (Attributes List) List of runner profiles in the workspace. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--profiles))

<a id="nestedatt--profiles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `profiles`

Read-Only:

- `access_level` (String) Controls which Namespace features the runner workload can access (`ACCESS_LEVEL_UNSPECIFIED`, `ACCESS_LEVEL_PERMISSIVE`, `ACCESS_LEVEL_LIMITED`, `ACCESS_LEVEL_RESTRICTED`).
- `builder_mode` (String) Build execution caching mode (`BUILDER_MODE_UNSPECIFIED`, `USE_REMOTE_BUILDER`, `USE_LOCAL_CACHE`, `NO_CACHING`).
- `cache_volume_settings` (Attributes List) Persistent cache volume attachments for this runner profile. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--profiles--cache_volume_settings))
- `created_at` (String) RFC3339Nano creation timestamp.
- `custom_runner_image_spec` (Attributes) Custom runner image specification (Ubuntu APT packages and/or inline Dockerfile). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--profiles--custom_runner_image_spec))
- `custom_runner_images` (Attributes List) List of custom runner image build statuses. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--profiles--custom_runner_images))
- `description` (String) Human-friendly description of the runner profile.
- `emoji` (String) Optional emoji visually identifying the profile in the Namespace UI.
- `experimental_features` (List of String) List of experimental feature flags enabled for this runner profile.
- `id` (String) Stable identifier for the runner profile in Terraform state, matching profile_id.
- `instance_shape` (Attributes) Instance compute shape configuration (CPU, memory, machine arch, OS). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--profiles--instance_shape))
- `network_policy` (Attributes) Network egress policy configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--profiles--network_policy))
- `os` (String) Base image operating system label (e.g. `ubuntu-24.04`, `macos-15`).
- `profile_id` (String) Unique server-assigned identifier for the runner profile.
- `swap_size_mb` (Number) Size of swap space to provision on the runner in megabytes.
- `tag` (String) Unique workspace alias for this runner profile.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC3339Nano last update timestamp.
- `version` (Number) Optimistic concurrency revision number for the runner profile.

<a id="nestedatt--profiles--cache_volume_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `profiles.cache_volume_settings`

Read-Only:

- `allow_commit_from_branch` (List of String) List of branch names allowed to write to this cache volume.
- `bundled_buildkit_cache` (Boolean) Whether to bundle BuildKit cache in this volume.
- `bundled_container_cache` (Boolean) Whether to bundle container image cache in this volume.
- `bundled_git_mirror` (Boolean) Whether to bundle git repository mirror in this volume.
- `bundled_runner_actions_cache` (Boolean) Whether to bundle GitHub Actions cache in this volume.
- `bundled_runner_tools_cache` (Boolean) Whether to bundle runner tool cache in this volume.
- `volume_reserved_size_gb` (Number) Reserved size that cannot be used by the cache, in gigabytes.
- `volume_size_gb` (Number) Total size of the cache volume in gigabytes.
- `volume_tag` (String) Unique identifier for this cache volume within the profile.


<a id="nestedatt--profiles--custom_runner_image_spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `profiles.custom_runner_image_spec`

Read-Only:

- `docker_spec` (Attributes) Dockerfile customizations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--profiles--custom_runner_image_spec--docker_spec))
- `ubuntu_spec` (Attributes) Ubuntu APT package customizations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--profiles--custom_runner_image_spec--ubuntu_spec))

<a id="nestedatt--profiles--custom_runner_image_spec--docker_spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `profiles.custom_runner_image_spec.docker_spec`

Read-Only:

- `dockerfile_content` (String) Dockerfile content to execute as an image layer on top of base image.


<a id="nestedatt--profiles--custom_runner_image_spec--ubuntu_spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `profiles.custom_runner_image_spec.ubuntu_spec`

Read-Only:

- `apt_package` (List of String) List of Ubuntu APT package names to install.



<a id="nestedatt--profiles--custom_runner_images"></a>
### Nested Schema for `profiles.custom_runner_images`

Read-Only:

- `build_ref` (String) Build reference identifier.
- `built_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when image build completed.
- `image_ref` (String) Registry image reference.
- `last_build_error` (String) Last image build error message if build failed.
- `last_error_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp of last build failure.
- `started_build_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when image build started.
- `status` (String) Image build status (`STATUS_UNKNOWN`, `BUILDING`, `READY`, `FAILED`).


<a id="nestedatt--profiles--instance_shape"></a>
### Nested Schema for `profiles.instance_shape`

Read-Only:

- `machine_arch` (String) Architecture of the instance (`amd64`, `arm64`).
- `memory_megabytes` (Number) Memory in megabytes.
- `os` (String) Compute OS family (`linux`, `macos`).
- `selectors` (Attributes List) Node label selectors for instance placement. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--profiles--instance_shape--selectors))
- `virtual_cpu` (Number) Number of virtual CPUs.

<a id="nestedatt--profiles--instance_shape--selectors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `profiles.instance_shape.selectors`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Selector key name.
- `value` (String) Selector value.



<a id="nestedatt--profiles--network_policy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `profiles.network_policy`

Read-Only:

- `advisory` (Boolean) When true, runs egress domain allowlist in advisory mode (log only, not blocked).
- `egress` (String) Egress policy mode (`EGRESS_POLICY_UNKNOWN`, `EGRESS_POLICY_NONE`, `EGRESS_POLICY_DOMAIN_ALLOW_LIST`, `EGRESS_POLICY_TAG`).
- `egress_domain_allow_list` (List of String) List of allowed domain names when egress mode is `EGRESS_POLICY_DOMAIN_ALLOW_LIST`.
- `egress_policy_tag` (String) Workspace policy tag to apply when egress mode is `EGRESS_POLICY_TAG`.
